# azd-reference evidence fixtures

The bound 1.1 fixtures were generated by the canonical producers merged at azd-reference commit `08e60886a8efc2c274f7ed9e2c2527e1771c1603`:

- `deployment-receipt-bound-v1.1.json`: deployment-receipt component 0.2.0
- `deployment-validation-bound-v1.1.json`: deployment-validation component 1.1.0

They are compatibility inputs for the native readers. The source component tags created for these versions did not pass the repository's signed-tag attestation gate, so compatibility is pinned to the reviewed merge commit rather than claiming an attested component release.
